input.prompt: Simulate the quenching process for Magnesium using LAMMPS by reading the molten structure from the data file /structures/task_31/heatedsystem_3000_reax.dat. The simulation should use metal units, atomic atom style, set periodic boundary conditions to True in all directions and use the Embedded Atom Method (EAM) potential. Run NPT simulations with timestep of 1 femtosecond using Nose-Hoover temperature thermostat and Nose-Hoover pressure barostat where temperature is cooled from 1000 K to 300 K at 0 atm pressure with pressure damping factor of 1.0 and temperature damping factor of 0.1 for 10,000 steps. After cooling, run NPT simulations at 300 K temperature and 0 atm pressure using Nose-Hoover temperature thermostat and Nose-Hoover pressure barostat with pressure damping factor of 1.0 and temperature damping factor of 0.1 for 10,000 steps. Finally, run NVT simulations at 300 K temperature using Nose-Hoover temperature thermostat with temperature damping factor of 0.1 for 10,000 steps. As the final output, give the density of the system in g/cm^3 units. This is a large simulation, hence multiple CPU cores are recommended.
